name: Repurpose a piece of work
audience: People who did the work once and want to use it again.
summary: Turn one case, talk, or guide into three smaller pieces without inventing results.
description: Turn one case, talk, or guide into three smaller pieces without inventing results. Four short lessons, a slide file, and a worksheet. Study it on your own.
benefits: Four lessons with an exercise each
Slides you can present to yourself or a colleague
compatibility: A text editor or Notion for the lessons
PowerPoint, Keynote, or Google Slides for the PPTX
A PDF reader for the worksheet
disclaimer: This is a self-study pack: lessons, slides, and exercises. It is not an accredited qualification and it does not include a tutor.
